title: Print name and amount
prompt: Print each entry as "name: amount", like "bolt: 3".
hints: Inside the loop, inventory[item] is the amount.

docs.name: for key in data:
docs.what: Runs once per key; data[key] gives its value.

docs.name: data[key]
docs.what: The value stored under key. Assigning to it changes or adds the entry.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
